title: Truthful and Expected-Payment-Optimal Model Routing in Graph-Based Agentic Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2610.19316v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Assigning routine tasks to cheaper large language model (LLM) providers can reduce generation cost, but switching providers may require processing accumulated context again. Keeping dependent tasks with the same provider can instead reuse eligible context. Graph-based workflows therefore couple routing decisions across tasks. Independent providers may also privately know their real-time unit costs and strategically misreport them. We formulate this routing problem as a single-parameter procurement auction and propose STAR (Strategy-proof Topology-aware Agent Routing), which minimizes virtual-cost-weighted graph workloads. Its allocation rule and payments, computed by integrating workload over possible cost reports, make truthful reporting utility-maximizing regardless of other providers' reports and cover each truthful provider's execution cost. translated_title: 基于图的智能体工作流中真实且期望支付最优的模型路由
translated_abstract: 将日常任务分配给更便宜的大语言模型（LLM）提供商可以降低生成成本，但切换提供商可能需要重新处理累积的上下文；而让相互依赖的任务保留在同一提供商处，则可以复用符合条件的上下文。因此，基于图的工作流使得各任务之间的路由决策相互耦合。此外，独立的提供商可能私下掌握其实时单位成本，并进行策略性谎报。我们将该路由问题形式化为一个单参数采购拍卖问题，并提出STAR（策略无懈可击的拓扑感知智能体路由）方法，该方法最小化以虚拟成本加权的图工作量。其分配规则和支付机制通过对可能的成本报告上的工作量进行积分来计算，使得无论其他提供商如何报告，如实报告都能最大化自身效用，同时能够覆盖每个如实报告的提供商的执行成本。在成本分布独立且虚拟成本非递减的条件下，STAR还能进一步实现期望支付最优。
tldr: 本文将基于图的智能体工作流中的LLM模型路由问题形式化为单参数采购拍卖，提出STAR机制，在保证提供商如实报价且覆盖其执行成本的同时，实现期望支付最优。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates LLM model routing in graph-based agentic workflows as a single-parameter procurement auction and proposes STAR, which ensures truthful reporting and cost coverage for providers while achieving optimal expected payments.
